decisions.evidence: R1 maker offers a choice — Q2 'Organization — are tags enough, or do you also want folders/collections?'; R1 client selects 'Tags should be the main organization method'.
decisions.note: Offered alternatives differ in fulfilment: folders/collections departs from the reference's tag-based model, tags conforms. Client picks the reference-conforming alternative -> select; offered decision marked diverged=true. Specification gate.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker default lists only tags/favorites/search, no saved filters; R1 client 'I'd also like reusable saved views combining a search with included or excluded tags.'
decisions.note: Bundles (saved search+included/excluded tags) absent from presented scope; client requests the missing reference requirement -> extend. Specification gate.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker Q3 'auto-fetch title (and maybe favicon/description)'; R1 client 'make metadata fetching best-effort for the title, description, favicon, and preview image, while still allowing everything to be edited manually.'
decisions.note: Presented metadata set omits preview image and hedges description/favicon; client supplies the full reference field set plus manual editability. Requesting the missing related requirement -> extend. Specification gate.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker default has no unread/read-later concept; R1 client 'I'd also want read-later status'.
decisions.note: Read-later state and its separate view were missing from presented scope; client requests it -> extend. Specification gate.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker default offers only edit/delete; R1 client 'reversible archiving'.
decisions.note: Archiving distinct from deletion (reversible) absent from presented scope; client requests it -> extend. Specification gate.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker default silent on duplicate URLs; R1 client 'duplicate URLs to open the existing bookmark for editing'.
decisions.note: Duplicate-URL convergence to editing the existing item missing from presented scope; client requests the reference behaviour -> extend. Specification gate.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker default lists no sort control; R1 client 'sorting'.
decisions.note: Sort-by-key missing from presented scope; client requests it -> extend. Specification gate.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker default has no multi-select; R1 client 'selecting bookmarks for bulk actions'.
decisions.note: Multi-select bulk actions missing from presented scope; client requests it -> extend. REF-BM-21 (apply to whole filtered collection) delivered in R2 but not explicitly stated by client. Specification gate.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker default has no import/export; R1 client 'import/export of standard browser bookmark files'.
decisions.note: Netscape HTML import/export missing from presented scope; client requests it -> extend. Specification gate.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker default 'Search by title/URL/notes and filter by tag'; R1 client 'Search should cover all bookmark text and tags, including exact phrases and simple AND/OR/NOT combinations.'
decisions.note: Presented search is a narrower subset (no phrase, no boolean, omits description); client requests the fuller reference search behaviour -> extend. Client scoped boolean to 'simple' AND/OR/NOT, not explicitly parenthesised groups (REF-BM-15 partial), but the boolean/phrase requirement is surfaced. Specification gate.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker default has no page snapshot; R1 client 'If practical, preserving a local copy of the linked page is important too.'
decisions.note: Local single-file snapshot missing from presented scope; client requests it (hedged 'if practical' but still a request) -> extend. Reference PDF sub-rule and Internet Archive (REF-BM-25) not raised by either party. Specification gate.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker default 'Add a bookmark by URL (+ optional title/notes)'; R1 client 'happy with that stack' and adjusts only other items.
decisions.note: Presented core behaviour conforms to reference; client accepts the default. Specification gate.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker default 'Edit and delete bookmarks'; client raises no objection.
decisions.note: Presented edit/delete conforms to reference. Specification gate.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker default 'Search ... and filter by tag'; client keeps it while extending search.
decisions.note: Tag filtering conforms to reference. Specification gate.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker default 'Favicon shown per bookmark' with title/notes/tags list; R2 maker readable list with title/description/tags/favicon; R2 client 'This looks complete ... covers what I need.'
decisions.note: Readability-first list exposing title/description/tags/favicon conforms to reference; final acceptance in R2 is bare approval (no new reference divergence surfaced). Implementation review.
